note: Keyword sets for X recent search. Narrative-first: topics only, never accounts (from:, to: and @ are refused). A set runs only when its status is 'approved' by the NPCC Comms lead (workflow step W1.1). Queries use X search syntax; recent search covers the last 7 days.

sets.label: Fake police notices and curfews
sets.query: (police OR constabulary) (curfew OR "fake notice" OR "fake letter" OR "not from us") lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Spiking claims
sets.query: (spiked OR spiking OR "injection spiking") (club OR bar OR freshers OR uni) lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Fake police fine texts
sets.query: ("police fine" OR "speeding fine" OR "penalty notice") (text OR sms OR scam) lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: False suspect identity after an incident
sets.query: (suspect OR attacker OR "arrested man" OR stabbing) ("real name" OR "his name is" OR asylum OR migrant OR "small boat" OR illegal) (police OR attack) lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Police cover-up claims
sets.query: (police OR cops) ("cover up" OR "covering up" OR coverup OR "hiding the truth" OR "won't tell us") lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Calls to gather or take to the streets
sets.query: ("get down there" OR "everyone meet" OR "be there at" OR "take it to the streets" OR "time to act") (hotel OR mosque OR "police station" OR protest) lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Old or recycled riot footage
sets.query: ("old footage" OR "old video" OR "not from today" OR "happening now" OR "right now") (riot OR riots OR disorder OR "petrol bomb" OR "police attacked") lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Fake police or government statements
sets.query: ("police statement" OR "police have confirmed" OR "home office confirmed" OR "official notice") (fake OR hoax OR "not real" OR doctored OR photoshopped) lang:en -is:retweet
